title: The Elision Rules
goal: Learn the three rules Rust uses to fill in omitted lifetimes.

sections.text: You omit lifetime annotations in most functions because the compiler fills them in automatically.

sections.caption: The compiler automatically expands this to include 'a.

sections.text: Rule one gives every omitted reference parameter its own lifetime parameter.
Rule two assigns that lifetime to all output references if there is exactly one input lifetime parameter.
Rule three assigns the lifetime of `&self` or `&mut self` to all output references when calling a method.
If multiple input references exist and none is `self`, elision fails and produces `E0106`.

explanation: Learn the three rules Rust uses to fill in omitted lifetimes.
